scope: Web presentation only; no model, audio protocol or desktop binary changes
checks: first streamed text reveals without waiting for the full answer
one 240 ms fade per new reply
old messages muted with normal history available
manual wheel, touch or paging exits focus
history restore does not replay animation or model request
new conversation and logout clear visual state
limits: Phone keyboard, gesture feel and voice acoustics still require physical-device experience.
Fade is visual only, not an operating-system window or keyboard focus change.
